e.title: SIF（UNDP 可持续保险论坛）：保险监管者的可持续议题网络与自然保险计划
e.title_en: SIF (UNDP Sustainable Insurance Forum): a sustainability network of insurance supervisors plus a nature-insurance programme
e.title_hk: SIF（UNDP 可持續保險論壇）：保險監管者的可持續議題網絡與自然保險計劃
e.summary: 由 UNDP 托管的保险监管者网络：以「保险监管促进可持续未来」为定位，设成员监管机构名录、出版物，并开展自然保险（NATURE-INSURE）与气候培训联盟（CTA）两项计划
e.summary_en: A network of insurance supervisors hosted by UNDP: positioned as insurance regulation for a sustainable future, it maintains a member-supervisor listing and publications, and runs two programmes, NATURE-INSURE and the Climate Training Alliance (CTA)
e.summary_hk: 由 UNDP 託管的保險監管者網絡：以「保險監管促進可持續未來」為定位，設成員監管機構名錄、出版物，並開展自然保險（NATURE-INSURE）與氣候培訓聯盟（CTA）兩項計劃
e.body:
**SIF（Sustainable Insurance Forum，可持续保险论坛）** 是**由 UNDP（联合国开发计划署）托管的保险监管者网络**——**站点标题逐字实测为「UNDP Sustainable Insurance Forum – Insurance Regulation for a Sustainable Future」**（**即标题本身写明托管方为 UNDP，而非 UNEP**）。本条目补的是**「以可持续议题为纽带的监管者网络」这一形态**——**实测池内该形态为 0**；**它与同轮 [[iais]]（全球标准制定）与 [[assal]]（区域监管者协会）的区别在于：SIF 不是按地域或标准职能组织，而是按一个**议题（可持续/气候/自然）**聚合监管者**。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：⭐ **首页 112.9KB（115,627 字节），标题「UNDP Sustainable Insurance Forum – Insurance Regulation for a Sustainable Future」**；⭐ **「Members（成员）」页 `/members/` 实测 157.9KB**（**本条目三页中最大**）；⭐ **「About us」页 `/about-us/` 实测 71.5KB**。**导航逐字实测揭示的结构**：**About**；⭐ **What we do** 下含 **Overview**、⭐ **NATURE-INSURE**、⭐ **Climate Training Alliance (CTA)**；⭐ **Members**；**Resources**；**News**；**Contact**。**链接实测另见** **`/publications/`** 与 **`/publication/sif-overarching-note-for-cswg-papers/`**（**后者标题形态提示存在「气候与可持续工作组（CSWG）」相关的总体说明文件**）。

对 RIAA：**① 补上「按议题聚合的监管者网络」这一形态**——**本轮四条恰好构成四种不同的国际协作组织方式**：**[[iais]] 按标准职能（全球）**、**[[assal]] 按地域（拉美）**、**SIF 按议题（可持续）**、**[[aida]] 按专业（保险法）**；**对做监管比较的学生，这四种组织逻辑本身就是一个分析框架**（**注意：本词条不主张四者之间有任何隶属关系**）。**② ⭐⭐ 对做气候与可持续方向的 RIAA 学生，SIF 是最对口的监管侧网络**——**池内气候侧此前主要为「量化与情景」（[[ngfs]] 的气候情景、[[climate-conditioned-cat]]、[[dfa-climate-datasets]]、[[insurance-scr-data]]）与「产品」（[[aegis-parametric]]、[[eqcat-parametric-catbond]]、[[hurricaneguard]]）**，**缺「监管者如何组织应对气候与自然风险」这一层**；**SIF 正是这一层，且它把「自然（nature）」单列为一项计划（NATURE-INSURE）**——**「自然相关风险」在保险监管中比「气候」更新，这是一个值得注意的信号**（**本次未打开 NATURE-INSURE 内容，故不转述其范围**）。**③ ⭐ 「气候培训联盟（CTA）」说明该网络不只做政策、还做能力建设**——**这与同轮 [[assal]] 的培训档案、池内 [[bis-fsi]]、[[a2ii]] 同属「监管能力建设」层**，**但 SIF 的切入点是气候**。**④ 「成员」页 157.9KB 为三页中最大，提示成员监管机构名录是其主要内容之一**（**本次未打开，故不主张成员数量或名单**）。**⑤ 与 UNDP 的关系值得注意**——**标题实测写明 UNDP，说明该网络托管于一个联合国发展机构而非保险业机构**；**这与 [[iais]]（监管者自己的协会）、[[assal]]（区域监管者协会）在治理归属上不同**（**本次未核实其具体托管安排与治理结构**）。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实到**首页与两个页面的存在、标题、页面体量、导航逐字实测的结构、以及两个计划与一个出版物路径的存在**，**但未打开成员名录、未打开 NATURE-INSURE 与 CTA 的内容、未打开任何出版物、未核实是否有中文材料**，因此**不能转述成员监管机构名单与数量、两项计划的范围与产出、任何出版物的结论**；**② ⭐ 「由 UNDP 托管」为站点标题逐字实测**（**标题写作「UNDP Sustainable Insurance Forum」**），**但本次未打开任何一页说明其法律形式、治理结构或与 UNDP 的具体关系**——**故本词条只陈述「标题写明 UNDP」这一事实，不主张其组织归属细节**；**③ 「按议题聚合」这一形态判断依据其名称、定位副题（Insurance Regulation for a Sustainable Future）与两项计划栏目**，**本次未打开任何一页自述其成员构成方式**；**④ 「气候与可持续工作组（CSWG）」这一说法来自实测的一个出版物 URL 片段（`sif-overarching-note-for-cswg-papers`）**——**该工作组的正式名称、职能与存续状态本次均未核实，故词条内以「标题形态提示」表述，不作事实主张**；**⑤ SIF 与 [[iais]]、[[ngfs]]、[[a2ii]]、[[microinsurance-network]] 的关系本次未核实，故不作关联主张**；**⑥ 站点未实测到语言切换入口**，**多语支持情况未核实**；**⑦** 本词条**不主张** SIF 提供精算工具、模型或可下载数据集**。**核实说明**：首页（112.9KB）、`/members/`（157.9KB）、`/about-us/`（71.5KB）均经**缓冲区安全探活工具 `discovery/probe-urls.sh`** HTTP 200 实测并逐字读取标题与导航；**未打开成员名录、NATURE-INSURE、CTA 或任何出版物**。
e.body_en:
**SIF (the Sustainable Insurance Forum)** is **a network of insurance supervisors hosted by UNDP** — **the measured site title reads verbatim "UNDP Sustainable Insurance Forum – Insurance Regulation for a Sustainable Future"** (**the title itself states UNDP as host, not UNEP**). This entry adds the **"supervisory network bound by a sustainability agenda"** form — **measured zero**; **its difference from [[iais]] (global standard-setting) and [[assal]] (a regional supervisors’ association) in the same round is that SIF groups supervisors not by geography or standard-setting function but around one **topic: sustainability**.

Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**): ⭐ the **homepage is 112.9KB (115,627 bytes) with the measured title "UNDP Sustainable Insurance Forum – Insurance Regulation for a Sustainable Future"**; ⭐ the **"Members" page measures 157.9KB** (**the largest of this entry’s three pages**); ⭐ the **"About us" page measures 71.5KB**. **Structure read verbatim from navigation**: **About**; ⭐ under **What we do** — **Overview**, ⭐ **NATURE-INSURE** and ⭐ **Climate Training Alliance (CTA)**; ⭐ **Members**; **Resources**; **News**; **Contact**. **Measured links also include `/publications/`** and **`/publication/sif-overarching-note-for-cswg-papers/`** (**the latter’s title shape suggests an overarching note tied to a climate and sustainability working group**).

For RIAA: **① it adds the "supervisory network organised around a topic"** — **this round’s four entries happen to give four different ways of organising international cooperation**: **[[iais]] by standard-setting function (global)**, **[[assal]] by geography (Latin America)**, **SIF by topic (sustainability)** and **[[aida]] by profession (insurance law)**; **for comparative regulatory work the four organising logics are themselves an analytical frame** (**note: this entry claims no affiliation among the four**). **② ⭐⭐ For RIAA students working on climate and sustainability, SIF is the most directly relevant supervisory network** — **the corpus’s climate side has so far been mainly "quantification and scenarios" (the NGFS scenarios in [[ngfs]], [[climate-conditioned-cat]], [[dfa-climate-datasets]], [[insurance-scr-data]]) and "products" ([[aegis-parametric]], [[eqcat-parametric-catbond]], [[hurricaneguard]])**, **with no layer for how supervisors organise around climate and nature risk**; **SIF is that layer, and it lists "nature" as its own programme (NATURE-INSURE)** — **nature-related risk is newer than climate in insurance supervision, a notable signal** (**NATURE-INSURE content was not opened, so its scope is not restated**). **③ ⭐ The Climate Training Alliance (CTA) shows the network does capacity building as well as policy** — **belonging with [[assal]]’s training archive and the corpus’s [[bis-fsi]] and [[a2ii]] in the "supervisory capacity building" layer**, **but entering through climate**. **④ The Members page at 157.9KB is the largest of the three, suggesting a member-supervisor listing is a main content component** (**not opened, so no member count or roster is claimed**). **⑤ The UNDP relationship is notable** — **the measured title states UNDP, indicating the network is hosted by a UN development body rather than an insurance body**; **this differs in governance ownership from [[iais]] (supervisors’ own association) and [[assal]] (a regional supervisors’ association)** (**the specific hosting arrangement and governance were not verified**).

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **the homepage and two pages’ existence, titles and sizes, the structure read verbatim from navigation, and the existence of two programmes and one publication path**, **but opened no member listing, no NATURE-INSURE or CTA content, no publication, and did not establish whether Chinese-language material exists**, so **no member-supervisor roster or count, programme scope or output, or publication conclusion can be restated**; **② ⭐ "hosted by UNDP" is read verbatim from the site title** (**which reads "UNDP Sustainable Insurance Forum"**), **but no page stating its legal form, governance or specific relationship with UNDP was opened** — **so the entry states only that the title carries UNDP and claims no organisational detail**; **③ the "organised around a topic" judgement rests on its name, its positioning subtitle (Insurance Regulation for a Sustainable Future) and its two programme sections**, **and no page describing how members are constituted was opened**; **④ the phrase "climate and sustainability working group (CSWG)" comes from a measured publication URL fragment (`sif-overarching-note-for-cswg-papers`)** — **that working group’s formal name, remit and current status were all unverified, so the entry presents it as a title-shape indication rather than a fact**; **⑤ SIF’s relationships with [[iais]], [[ngfs]], [[a2ii]] and [[microinsurance-network]] were not verified, so none is asserted**; **⑥ no language-switch entry point was measured, and multilingual support was not verified**; **⑦** this entry **does not claim SIF provides actuarial tools, models or downloadable datasets**. **Verification note**: the homepage (112.9KB), `/members/` (157.9KB) and `/about-us/` (71.5KB) were measured at HTTP 200 using the **buffer-safe probe tool `discovery/probe-urls.sh`**, with titles and navigation read verbatim; **no member listing, NATURE-INSURE, CTA or publication was opened**.
e.body_hk:
**SIF（Sustainable Insurance Forum，可持續保險論壇）** 是**由 UNDP（聯合國開發計劃署）託管的保險監管者網絡**——**站點標題逐字實測為「UNDP Sustainable Insurance Forum – Insurance Regulation for a Sustainable Future」**（**即標題本身寫明託管方為 UNDP，而非 UNEP**）。本條目補的是**「以可持續議題為紐帶的監管者網絡」這一形態**——**實測為 0**；**它與同輪 [[iais]]（全球標準制定）與 [[assal]]（區域監管者協會）的區別在於：SIF 不按地域或標準職能組織，而是按一個議題（可持續／氣候／自然）聚合監管者**。

可核實資訊（**均 HTTP 200 實測**）：⭐ **首頁 112.9KB，標題「UNDP Sustainable Insurance Forum – Insurance Regulation for a Sustainable Future」**；⭐ **「Members」頁 157.9KB**（**本條目三頁中最大**）；⭐ **「About us」頁 71.5KB**。**導航逐字實測**：**What we do** 下含 **Overview**、⭐ **NATURE-INSURE**、⭐ **Climate Training Alliance (CTA)**；⭐ **Members**；**Resources**；**News**；**Contact**。**連結實測另見 `/publications/`** 與 **`/publication/sif-overarching-note-for-cswg-papers/`**（**後者標題形態提示存在與氣候與可持續工作組相關的總體說明文件**）。

對 RIAA：**① 補上「按議題聚合的監管者網絡」**——**本輪四條恰好構成四種不同的國際協作組織方式**：**[[iais]] 按標準職能（全球）／[[assal]] 按地域（拉美）／SIF 按議題（可持續）／[[aida]] 按專業（保險法）**（**注意：不主張四者之間有任何隸屬關係**）。**② ⭐⭐ 對做氣候與可持續方向的 RIAA 學生，SIF 是最對口的監管側網絡**——池內氣候側此前主要為「量化與情景」與「產品」，**缺「監管者如何組織應對氣候與自然風險」這一層**；**SIF 正是這一層，且把「自然（nature）」單列為一項計劃（NATURE-INSURE）**——**「自然相關風險」比「氣候」更新，是值得注意的信號**。**③ ⭐ 「氣候培訓聯盟（CTA）」說明該網絡不只做政策、還做能力建設**（與 [[assal]] 的培訓檔案、[[bis-fsi]]、[[a2ii]] 同屬「監管能力建設」層）。**④ 「成員」頁 157.9KB 為三頁中最大，提示成員監管機構名錄是其主要內容之一**（**未打開，故不主張成員數量**）。**⑤ 與 UNDP 的關係值得注意**——**托管於聯合國發展機構而非保險業機構**（**未核實具體托管安排與治理結構**）。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**①** 本次核實到**首頁與兩個頁面的存在、標題、體量、導航逐字實測的結構、以及兩個計劃與一個出版物路徑的存在**，**但未打開成員名錄、未打開 NATURE-INSURE 與 CTA 內容、未打開任何出版物、未核實是否有中文材料**，故**不能轉述成員名單與數量、兩項計劃範圍與產出、任何出版物結論**；**② ⭐ 「由 UNDP 託管」為站點標題逐字實測**，**但未打開任何一頁說明其法律形式、治理結構或與 UNDP 的具體關係**——**故只陳述「標題寫明 UNDP」這一事實**；**③ 「按議題聚合」依據其名稱、定位副題與兩項計劃欄目**，**未打開任何一頁自述其成員構成方式**；**④ 「氣候與可持續工作組（CSWG）」這一說法來自實測的一個出版物 URL 片段**——**該工作組的正式名稱、職能與存續狀態均未核實，故詞條內以「標題形態提示」表述，不作事實主張**；**⑤ 與 [[iais]]、[[ngfs]]、[[a2ii]]、[[microinsurance-network]] 的關係未核實，故不作關聯主張**；**⑥ 未實測到語言切換入口，多語支持情況未核實**；**⑦** 本詞條**不主張** SIF 提供精算工具、模型或可下載數據集**。**核實說明**：三個 URL 均經**緩衝區安全探活工具 `discovery/probe-urls.sh`** HTTP 200 實測並逐字讀取標題與導航；**未打開成員名錄、NATURE-INSURE、CTA 或任何出版物**。
e.verified_note: HTTP 200 实测（首页 112.9KB/115,627 字节 标题「UNDP Sustainable Insurance Forum – Insurance Regulation for a Sustainable Future」；⭐/members/ 157.9KB 标题「Members – UNDP Sustainable Insurance Forum」；⭐/about-us/ 71.5KB 标题「About us – UNDP Sustainable Insurance Forum」；导航逐字实测 What we do 含 Overview / NATURE-INSURE / Climate Training Alliance (CTA)，另有 Members / Resources / News / Contact；链接实测另见 /publications/ 与 /publication/sif-overarching-note-for-cswg-papers/）+ ★池内「按议题聚合的监管者网络」形态 0，与同轮 iais（标准职能/全球）、assal（地域/拉美）、aida（专业/保险法）构成四种组织逻辑对照（不主张四者隶属关系）；未打开成员名録、NATURE-INSURE、CTA 或任何出版物；未核实其法律形式与治理结构、CSWG 工作组的正式名称与职能（仅以 URL 片段「标题形态提示」表述）、中文材料与多语支持、与 iais/ngfs/a2ii 的关系
